# codeweb

> See what your AI edits affect. codeweb maps a repository into a deterministic call/import graph — 28 MCP tools for coding agents (Claude Code plugin & MCP server) plus a self-contained interactive map for humans. Free & MIT; zero runtime dependencies; Node >= 22; runs entirely locally; reads code, never executes it; no LLM in the analysis loop.

Key measured facts (each traces to a published result file in the evidence ledger on the Research page):
- AI agents found 74% of a function's real callers with the map vs 44% with grep, at the same context cost (efficiency-pilot.reps5-v090.json).
- "What breaks if I change this" answered at ~1KB per call vs ~130KB for a simulated grep loop — 126x cheaper (oracle-ab.json).
- ~490,000 query answers checked against independent oracles, 0 disagreements (correctness-query.json).
- Byte-deterministic: 1 distinct digest per repo across 20 runs on all 6 test repos (determinism.json).
- 13 languages extracted natively: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Rust, Go, Java, C#, Ruby, PHP, Kotlin, Swift, C, C++ (auxiliary.json).

Install:
- Claude Code plugin: `/plugin marketplace add GhostlyGawd/codeweb` then `/plugin install codeweb`
- One-shot map of the current repo: `npx -y @ghostlygawd/codeweb .`
- MCP server (any MCP client): `claude mcp add codeweb -- npx -y -p @ghostlygawd/codeweb codeweb-mcp`

## Pages
- [Home](https://codeweb-hq.github.io/codeweb/): See what your AI edits affect. Structural checks for AI code changes. Trace callers before an edit. Check changes for new dependency cycles, body-confirmed duplication, and lost callers. Local static analysis supplies 28 MCP tools and a supporting report. No LLM in the checks. A passing result does not prove the program works.
- [28 MCP tools & the CI structural gate](https://codeweb-hq.github.io/codeweb/product.html): The 28 deterministic MCP tools, the Tier 0–3 feature map, 13-language call/import graph extraction, and the CI gate that fails a PR when an edit makes the structure worse.
- [Research, benchmarks & the honest claim ledger](https://codeweb-hq.github.io/codeweb/research.html): A pre-registered effectiveness study (32 checks, all 32 passing), an efficiency pilot, and an honest claim ledger: what is validated, what is preliminary, and what is a null result.
- [Get started — install the codebase-map plugin, npx, or MCP server](https://codeweb-hq.github.io/codeweb/start.html): Install codeweb as a Claude Code plugin, run the npx one-liner, or register the MCP server for Cursor/Windsurf. Free & MIT; runs entirely on your machine; Node ≥ 22.
- [Changelog](https://codeweb-hq.github.io/codeweb/changelog.html): Every release, capability, benchmark, and fix — kept in lock-step with the product under Keep a Changelog and Semantic Versioning.
- [Historical technical example: mapping axios](https://codeweb-hq.github.io/codeweb/case-study.html): July 2026 technical record of axios v1.18.1: three body-confirmed duplication findings. Historical counts differ from the current demo; no maintainer acceptance is recorded.
- [Support codeweb — sponsorship & org support](https://codeweb-hq.github.io/codeweb/support.html): Everything local is free forever. Sponsoring supports the project, and sponsors get featured placement in the README and on the site. Org support by email.
- [Free forever / Teams — where the paid line sits](https://codeweb-hq.github.io/codeweb/boundary.html): The ratified boundary: anything that runs on one laptop against one repo is free forever (MIT, no accounts, no telemetry, no license keys); money buys hosting, multi-repo aggregation, and human attention.
- [codeweb Teams pricing — €10 per active author, flat and unlimited](https://codeweb-hq.github.io/codeweb/pricing.html): Planned codeweb Teams pricing: €10 per active author per month, flat — unlimited repos, PRs, and gate runs, with no credits or per-review metering. An active author committed on a gated default branch in the trailing 90 days.
- [codeweb vs a language server (LSP) — why a whole-graph map](https://codeweb-hq.github.io/codeweb/lsp.html): A language server answers one hop on demand; codeweb builds one deterministic whole-graph artifact. Transitive impact, duplication, dead code, and the diffable snapshot a CI gate needs — each with the committed benchmark that produced its number.
- [codeweb vs grep and one-hop lookups — every number regenerable](https://codeweb-hq.github.io/codeweb/compare.html): A comparison where every number traces to a committed, re-runnable benchmark: +0.31 caller recall at equal token cost, 126x smaller measured context size than a simulated grep loop, 0 disagreements over 497,864 independent checks — and the results that did not replicate, dropped.
- [Live demo](https://codeweb-hq.github.io/codeweb/demo/): A real interactive codeweb map of axios — 274 product symbols, 8 domains, body-confirmed duplication findings. No mockups.
